name: The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon
description: After washing ashore in France, Daryl struggles to piece together how he got there and why, as he navigates a fractured, walker-infested landscape to find his way home. During his journey, Daryl has to protect a young boy, Laurent, who is seen as a messiah, while facing new, dangerous walker variants and the "Power of the Living" paramilitary group, as the connections he forms along the way complicate his plan to return home.

videos.title: L'âme Perdue
videos.overview: Daryl Dixon's arrival in France puts a young boy under the care of nuns in danger.

videos.title: Alouette
videos.overview: Daryl, Isabelle, Laurent, and Sylvie face trouble on the road. Isabelle remembers the day the hungry ones appeared. Laurent struggles to fit in.

videos.title: Paris sera toujours Paris
videos.overview: The group arrives in Paris, where Isabelle confronts her past while growing closer to Daryl. Codron seeks help from the leader of a growing nationalist movement called Pouvoir, putting the Union of Hope and Laurent under dangerous scrutiny.

videos.title: La Dame de Fer
videos.overview: Daryl and Isabelle must negotiate with Quinn, the proprietor of the underground Demimonde club - the last vestige of art and expression in Paris.

videos.title: Deux Amours
videos.overview: Daryl faces old demons, recalling the circumstances that landed him in France. Isabelle's sacrifice forces her to consider drastic measures. Genet commences a celebration for the people of Paris.

videos.title: Coming Home
videos.overview: Genet solidifies her base of power. Before Daryl can return to America, he has a job to do.

videos.title: The Book of Carol: La gentillesse des étrangers
videos.overview: Carol maps a path toward Daryl. Daryl, Isabelle, and Laurent define their roles at the Nest.

videos.title: The Book of Carol: Moulin Rouge
videos.overview: Carol and Ash take an unexpected detour. Daryl and Isabelle uncover a new threat at the Nest.

videos.title: The Book of Carol: L'invisible
videos.overview: Carol hunts for information. Daryl and Isabelle race to save one of their own. Pouvoir regroups.

videos.title: The Book of Carol: Le Paradis Pour Toi
videos.overview: All hope feels lost amidst Genet's attack on the Nest.

videos.title: The Book of Carol: Vouloir, C'est Pouvoir
videos.overview: A new faction of survivors hunt down Laurent. Carol's lies come to a head.

videos.title: The Book of Carol: Au Revoir Les Enfants
videos.overview: An exit strategy is charted from France.

videos.title: Costa da Morte
videos.overview: A chance encounter provides a potential way home; Daryl makes a tough decision.

videos.title: La Ofrenda
videos.overview: Shipwrecked in Spain, Daryl and Carol seek refuge in a peaceful village.

videos.title: El Sacrificio
videos.overview: Daryl focuses on getting home while Carol gets more invested in Solaz.

videos.title: La Justicia Fronteriza
videos.overview: Daryl and Carol disagree on how to move forward. A surprise attack changes everything.

videos.title: Limbo
videos.overview: Carol helps Antonio and Roberto while Daryl journeys into the desert in search of someone.

videos.title: Contrabando
videos.overview: Daryl and Paz in Barcelona. Carol and Antonio face the fallout of Solaz.

videos.title: Solaz del Mar
videos.overview: Our heroes fight to protect the people they love.
